faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at MDU?
faq.answer: Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak is recruiting for Research Assistant, Project Fellow, and Field Investigator posts under an HSRF sponsored research project at the Centre for Professional & Allied Studies - Gurugram.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in MDU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available, which include 1 Research Assistant, 1 Project Fellow, and 5 Field Investigator posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the tentative date of the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date of the interview is 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for a Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Postgraduate in Management, Economics, Statistics, Commerce, Education, Social Sciences, or allied disciplines with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD) & PhD/NET in the concerned subject.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for a Field Investigator?
faq.answer: Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in conducting field surveys, data collection, communication in Hindi and English, and willingness to travel across Haryana.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration for a Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The remuneration for a Project Fellow is ₹25,000/- per month for a maximum tenure of 6 months.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for MDU Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit soft copies of the filled-in application form along with self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for MDU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interviews be held and will TA/DA be paid?
faq.answer: Candidates shall have to appear physically for the interview, and no TA/DA shall be paid.
